svg.title: Ha Yanagi — Lament of the Willow. Draft 2 / Ha Yanagi classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Mourning Boughs forks into Veil of Falling Petals then Grave Willow's Hush, or Blight Takes Root then Hollow at the Heart. Whispering Canopy forks into Hardened Heartwood then Nightmare in Bloom, or Rising Sap then Thousand-Leaf Dream. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Ha Yanagi jutsu (bloodline-keyed classification, proposed extension).

Increase Damage Given is one self row at 35% whose four-stat, element-less filter matches every non-pierce hit the caster lands in the two rounds after the cast; it is tertiary by coverage breadth, not by flat size, and carries the deepest single-row ladder (+10). Dream"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":null,"design_notes":["Node split: Taiyo Kami's 2/4/4 fork shape with kit-specific flats (only the +2/+3 Damage ladder repeats Crown of Cinders \u2192 Solar Cataclysm: both reach multi-row damage). Mourning Boughs (enemy) opens both suppression rows and forks into Veil of Falling Petals \u2192 Grave Willow's Hush and Blight Takes Root \u2192 Hollow at the Heart (exposure). Whispering Canopy (self) opens the Wailing Bark buff and forks into Hardened Heartwood \u2192 Nightmare in Bloom and Rising Sap \u2192 Thousand-Leaf Dream (amplifier).","Flats scale with coverage. Decrease Damage Given reaches two enemy rows that stack on one target (35% + 30%), so it takes +2/+2/+4 (max +8: 43/38%, 81% stacked) instead of a single-row +2/+3/+5. Increase Damage Taken is one enemy row at 30%: +3/+5 (max +8, 38%) with a +2 suppression secondary that equals, not out-bids, the sibling Hidden Art. Damage reaches two 40-power rows: +2/+3 (max +5, 45 each). Increase Damage Given is one self row at 35%: the single-row ladder +3/+3/+4 (max +10, 45%).","Main tree, passives, pierce: every percentage row lists all four stat types and no element; getEfficiencyRatio returns 1 on any stat overlap, so each matches damage of any element (\u00a73). Jutsu-sourced modifiers add power/100 \u00d7 staged base (\u00a73b): the Wailing Bark buff adds to normal jutsu, weapons and basic attacks in its window, suppression subtracts from the target's hits, exposure adds to allies' hits. Only the +15% bloodline IDG passive multiplies. Pierce runs after the modifier pass.","Delivery and uptime: all three casts are OTHER_USER SINGLE. Wailing Bark is 40 AP, cooldown 6, range 5 (suppression row plus the SELF buff, so both roots touch it); Blighted Tree 60 AP, cooldown 7, range 4 (formula damage plus exposure); Petal Nightmare 60 AP, cooldown 6, range 4 (static damage plus suppression). Every percentage row is live the two rounds after its cast round, never in it (\u00a73b). Both suppression debuffs on one target in one turn cost 100 AP: 81% is a ceiling, not a rotation. Not simulated.","Fourth purchases and dominance: Suppression adds Whispering Canopy (38% buff) or Blight Takes Root (33%); Exposure adds Veil of Falling Petals (41/36%) or Whispering Canopy; Burst adds Rising Sap (43% buff) or Mourning Boughs (37/32%); Amplifier adds Mourning Boughs or Hardened Heartwood. 13 of 14 full builds are non-dominated and every node appears in one; the dominated 01+02+04+06 (suppression +4, exposure +3, buff +3) loses to 01+04+05+06 on exposure at equal suppression and buff.","Tuning (user-owned, D8): full builds run 14 (Amplifier) to 20 (Exposure) by row weight, Suppression/Burst 18-19; Taiyo Kami is 3.4 per row, this tree 3.3. Kept as drafted: Thousand-Leaf Dream +4 (Amplifier thinness accepted, risk 5) and Hollow at the Heart's +2 suppression secondary (equals Veil of Falling Petals). Options: Thousand-Leaf Dream +4/+1 Damage (row weight 16), or +5 with Rising Sap +2 (+5 alone breaches +10); Hollow's secondary +1 or none (Exposure 18 or 16)."],"risks":["Classification: no row carries an element, so the proposed 'Ha Yanagi' label is a bloodline-keyed extension of the whole-kit classification change. Under the current resolver all 6 supported rows fall back to None, which also reaches every non-elemental row on any jutsu the player casts; the normal-jutsu collision is unverified. The tree is inert until that extension exists.","Suppression stacking: Wailing Bark and Petal Nightmare each apply a separate two-round Decrease Damage Given debuff; with BATTLE_TAG_STACKING on every active same-tag effect applies (process.ts 1109\u20131117, \u00a73b) and jutsu-sourced percentages add, so one target loses 65% of the staged base of each non-pierce hit at base and 81% at the route maximum (getPower caps each row, not the sum). Flats held to +2/+2/+4 for this; not simulated.","Leakage: every percentage row has all four stat types and no element, so the enhanced Wailing Bark self buff adds to normal jutsu, weapons and basic attacks in the two rounds after the cast; suppression cuts non-pierce damage from every source the target controls; exposure raises non-pierce hits from allies and weapons. Restricted casting scope does not restrict downstream benefit.","Pierce: the kit has no pierce rows and no node touches pierce. At the pin pierce is applied after the damage-modifier pass (process.ts 416-430, 563-577), so the Suppression and Exposure routes do not reduce or amplify enemy pierce hits and the self buff does not raise any pierce the player lands.","Single-window concentration, accepted as a narrow-identity trade: the Amplifier route's whole value is one 35\u219245% self row live the two rounds after each 40 AP Wailing Bark cast (cooldown 6). It is the thinnest full build (row weight 14, tied with four capstone-free hybrids) and Thousand-Leaf Dream the lightest Advanced Art (4 vs 8-9); lift options in design note 6. Exposure likewise rides one 30\u219238% Blighted Tree row (cooldown 7).","Targeting: all three casts are OTHER_USER and may be aimed at any living non-caster user, allies included (util.ts 2747\u20132749; actions.ts 1029\u20131068). Every damage and debuff row has friendly fire none/ALL, so aimed at an ally it damages, suppresses (37-43%) or exposes that ally, while Wailing Bark's SELF buff still lands on the caster. SINGLE method, so this is player-controlled; the dossier marks no ally-hazard rows.","Standing self exposure: the bloodline's permanent +5% Increase Damage Taken passive (Taijutsu/Bukijutsu filter, no element, so it also matches every element-less hit) is a passive, not a jutsu row; no node raises or removes it. The Suppression route offsets it on debuffed targets only. The dossier marks no adverse supported rows, so no node makes any row worse for the caster.","Rank and scope: Ha Yanagi is a D-rank bloodline; this tree equalises marginal opportunity, not final strength; cross-bloodline comparison is deferred to the roster review. Blighted Tree's Damage row is formula-calculated, so +5 raw power lands differently from +5 on Petal Nightmare's static row. Normal-tree potency policy is unapproved; no combat simulation was performed."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":10,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":4,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":10,"4":14},"full_budget_allocations":14,"non_dominated_full_allocations":13,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":10,"decreasedamagegiven":8,"increasedamagetaken":8},"supported_rows_in_kit":6,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":2,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagegiven":1,"increasedamagetaken":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","decreasedamagegiven","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 2 / Ha Yanagi classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Ha Yanagi jutsu inherit Ha Yanagi potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit."]},"legal_full_budget_builds":[{"ids":["01","02","03","04"],"bonuses":{"decreasedamagegiven":8,"increasedamagetaken":3}},{"ids":["01","02","03","06"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":3,"decreasedamagegiven":8}},{"ids":["01","02","04","05"],"bonuses":{"decreasedamagegiven":6,"increasedamagetaken":8}},{"ids":["01","02","04","06"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":3,"decreasedamagegiven":4,"increasedamagetaken":3}},{"ids":["01","02","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":3,"decreasedamagegiven":4}},{"ids":["01","02","06","09"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":6,"decreasedamagegiven":4}},{"ids":["01","04","05","06"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":3,"decreasedamagegiven":4,"increasedamagetaken":8}},{"ids":["01","04","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":3,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":3}},{"ids":["01","04","06","09"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":6,"decreasedamagegiven":2,"increasedamagetaken":3}},{"ids":["01","06","07","08"],"bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":5,"decreasedamagegiven":2}},{"ids":["01","06","07","09"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":6,"decreasedamagegiven":2}},{"ids":["01","06","09","10"],"bonuses":{"increasedamagegiven":10,"decreasedamagegiven":2}},{"ids":["06","07","08","09"],"bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":8}},{"ids":["06","07","09","10"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":10}}]}

g.text: Draft 2 / Ha Yanagi classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Ha Yanagi jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Grave Willow's Hush path + Whispering Canopy
Hollow at the Heart path + Veil of Falling Petals
Nightmare in Bloom path + Rising Sap
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
